final_claim.narrative: A time-respecting reachability query from 303 to 1293 with the required maximum inter-event wait of 600 returned no route (step_01). To rule out that the failure was solely due to the tight max-wait constraint, I repeated the reachability check with a very large max_wait and still found no route (step_02). Together these temporal checks indicate there is no cascade from 303 to 1293 within [46296,48695].
